Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the time earlier this morning — great to meet you and the AcmeBank team. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed: 

- Redwood recap: hosted API for rapid proof-of-concept, Dedicated/Private for isolated key management and on-prem needs.
- Primary compliance asks you flagged: SOC 2 Type II evidence, GDPR data residency, and HIPAA / BAA requirements for PHI.
- KMS/key mgmt questions: whether we can support customer-managed keys (BYOK), HSM-backed keys, and separation of duties for key access.

Actions / next steps: 
1) I will start a vendor security questionnaire for you to complete (link below).
2) Ive looped in Marissa from Security to run a technical deep-dive and share SOC 2 evidence.
3) Please confirm whether AcmeBank needs keys fully customer-controlled for hosted traffic, or if a Dedicated/Private deployment is acceptable.

High-level answers to the KMS questions we talked about:
- In-transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced with mutual TLS options for Dedicated/Private.
- At-rest: AES-256 encryption for stored artifacts.
- Customer-managed keys: Supported for Dedicated and Private deployments via AWS KMS integration and HSM options; hosted API can be configured for CMK in dedicated/private but by default uses Redwood-managed keys.

I attached a short FAQ on KMS options and a SOC 2 summary will follow from Marissa.

Link to questionnaire: https://forms.gle/redwood-vendor-questionnaire

Thanks Alice — great questions. Ive answered inline below and included next steps. Marissa, Rachel — adding you for the technical/controls follow-up and to share SOC 2 evidence.

1) Hosted API & BYOK/HSM:
- Hosted API (our multi-tenant public endpoint) uses Redwood-managed keys by default and does NOT currently expose a BYOK flow for that endpoint.
- BYOK/HSM-backed keys are supported for Redwood Dedicated (reserved pools) and Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem). In those modes we integrate with AWS KMS and can support external HSMs for on-prem deployments.

2) KMS ownership & rotation:
- For Dedicated/Private, customers can own the CMK in their cloud account (AWS KMS) and control rotation and policies. We support a customer-controlled KMS key policy and do not store the unencrypted key material.

3) Key usage audit logs:
- We surface key-use metadata in our audit logs; for Dedicated/Private we can integrate with customer CloudTrail/Syslog for key events. For hosted customers we provide redacted audit trails and token-level usage logs. We can export logs to your SIEM in Dedicated/Private setups.

4) HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood offers a BAA for customers with PHI when on Dedicated or Private deployments. We can discuss scope during contracting; hosted customers can be evaluated case-by-case.

Attachments: Im including our SOC 2 Type II report and an expanded KMS FAQ for your security team to review. Marissa, can you confirm the SOC 2 package and the earliest availability for a 60-90 minute technical deep-dive?

Proposed next steps: 
- Alice: please complete the attached questionnaire or let us know if youd prefer we answer directly in your spreadsheet.
- Procurement: we can circulate a DPA / BAA (DocuSign link below) once the questionnaire is in flight.
- Marissa: suggest Tue/Wed next week 10-12 PT for the security deep-dive.
